description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Vivi (Fire)], [MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode
description.text: Keeps track of TP level (0~6), increases TP level by 1 when the character is hit by a damaging attack or an ally uses a damaging action, casts a certain ability when TP level reaches 6. Removed after 8 abilities.

description.name: Tactical Awoken Mode: Vivi (Fire)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [111% ATB 1] after using Fire abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (31.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Fire Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Fire 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical) V2], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Fire Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Fire 142% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)] to user if Level 2+ EnFire, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] to user if not.
